entities.name: Tracking area identity
entities.description: Information element providing unambiguous identification of tracking areas within the 3GPP system coverage area. It is a type 3 IE with 6 octets length.

entities.name: Mobile Country Code
entities.description: Mobile Country Code field coded according to ITU-T Rec. E212, annex A. Contains 3 digits stored in octets 2-3.

entities.name: Mobile Network Code
entities.description: Mobile Network Code field using BCD coding, consisting of 2 or 3 digits. For 2-digit MNC, bits 5-8 of octet 3 are coded as '1111'.

entities.name: Tracking Area Code
entities.description: Tracking Area Code consisting of 2 octets where bit 8 of octet 5 is MSB and bit 1 of octet 6 is LSB. Used to mark TAI as deleted when set to specific values.

entities.name: Abnormal MCC condition
entities.description: Condition where MCC stored in UE contains elements not in {0,1...9}. UE transmits using full hexadecimal encoding and network treats TAI as deleted.

entities.name: Abnormal MNC condition
entities.description: Condition where MNC stored in UE has digit 1/2 not in {0,1...9} or digit 3 not in {0,1...9,F}. UE transmits using full hexadecimal encoding and network treats TAI as deleted.

entities.name: TAI deleted condition
entities.description: Condition where TAI is marked as deleted. All TAC bits set to one except least significant bit set to zero, or TAC containing all zeros.

entities.name: TAI deleted handling
entities.description: Behavior where MCC and MNC take values from deleted TAI, and network treats TAI as deleted when receiving abnormal MCC/MNC values.

Tracking area identity IE contains Mobile Network Code field
Tracking area identity IE contains Tracking Area Code field
Abnormal MCC condition establishes TAI deleted handling behavior
Abnormal MNC condition establishes TAI deleted handling behavior
